briefing.headline: OBX surges 42.7% as alt‑token rally tops overnight moves
briefing.summary: Core US mega‑cap tech stocks were split, with META, MSFT and AAPL down modestly while AMD, GOOGL and NVDA edged higher. Breadth was narrow (6 advancers vs 4 decliners) and the overall core average was a slight -0.17%. A group of non‑core tokens—OBX, FLY, KRMN, ARQQ, LYNX, IONX, AOSL—posted explosive gains above 20%, offset by sharp drops in AMN, IRTC and OPEN. The picture was mixed: risk‑off in the core segment but buoyed by high‑beta alternatives.
